title: On A Single Eye

passages.locator: https://wesley.nnu.edu/john-wesley/the-sermons-of-john-wesley-1872-edition/sermon-118-on-a-single-eye/; original.html, heading block under the title (block 1): "If thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
